summary: This PR simplifies the code for setting PGPASSWORD in the postgres backend, but introduces a minor maintainability/readability defect due to the removal of a commented-out section.

issues.description: The removed commented-out section contained a docstring, which should be updated or preserved in the new code.
The removal of the commented-out section may make the code slightly less readable, as it removes a clear explanation of the purpose of the _escape_pgpass function.
